tasks.title: pipeline normalize
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python: def normalize(s): return s.strip().lower()
def tokens(s): return normalize(s).split()
assert tokens('  Hi There ')==['hi','there']
print(tokens('  Hi There '))

tasks.title: scratch-style modules in one file
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python simulating two modules in one file:
# module util
def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x))
# module app
def score(x): return clamp(x, 0, 100)
assert score(-5)==0 and score(150)==100 and score(50)==50
print(score(50))
